Looking at the errors, the main issue is that `ST_Pump` type is not defined. The interface references this type, but it hasn't been declared. I need to add the TYPE definition before the FUNCTION_BLOCK.

```json
{
  "edits": [
    {
      "old": "FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_MultiPumpControl
VAR_INPUT
    mode : BOOL;          // FALSE: Manual mode, TRUE: Automatic mode
    start : BOOL;         // Start button
    stop : BOOL;          // Stop button
END_VAR",
      "new": "TYPE ST_Pump :
STRUCT
    priority : INT;
    selection : BOOL;
    RunComd : BOOL;
END_STRUCT
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_MultiPumpControl
VAR_INPUT
    mode : BOOL;          // FALSE: Manual mode, TRUE: Automatic mode
    start : BOOL;         // Start button
    stop : BOOL;          // Stop button
END_VAR"
    }
  ]
}
```
